description: Flooding susceptibility zones WMS is a dataset listed in Geonorge, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ivar Peereboom. Flomsoner viser arealer som oversvømmes ved ulike flomstørrelser (gjentaksintervall). Det blir utarbeidet flomsoner for 20-, 200- og 1000-årsflommene. I områder der klimaendringene gir en forventet økning i vannføringen på mer enn 20 %, utarbeides det flomsone for 200-årsflommen i år 2100. Coverage: Ivar Peereboom. The publisher named on the listing is Ivar Peereboom. Its keywords include wms_flomsoner, Flomsoner 20, Flomsoner 500, Norge fastland, Flomsoner 200, Flomsoner 50. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 0001-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.norge.no/nlod/no/1.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geonorge.
